title: The Killing Jar
cast: Michael Madsen, Harold Perrineau, Danny Trejo, Kevin Gage, Lew Temple
description: A stranger armed with a shotgun takes seven patrons hostage in a remote roadside diner. But as the body count increases, the desperate survivors discover that one of the hostages may be even more dangerous than their captor.

title: Who Killed Captain Alex?
cast: Kakule William, Sserunya Ernest, G. Puffs, Bukenya Charles, Kavubu Muhammed
description: Recognized as Uganda’s first action film, Who Killed Captain Alex? is about the aftermath of a police raid in Kampala in which a police captain is killed.

title: 6 Guns
cast: Sage Mears, Anya Benton, Jason Ellefson, Greg Evigan, Valerie K. Garcia
description: When her family is gunned down in cold blood, a young girl convinces a bounty hunter to train her as a gunfighter so she can seek vengeance with a six-shooter.

title: Red Dog
cast: Josh Lucas, Rachael Taylor, Rohan Nichol, Luke Ford, Arthur Angel
description: The legendary true story of the Red Dog who united a disparate local community while roaming the Australian outback in search of his long lost master.

title: William & Kate
cast: Camilla Luddington, Nico Evers-Swindell, Victoria Tennant, Charles Shaughnessy, Ben Cross
description: Inspired by the royal wedding and retelling the highs and lows of the nine-year courtship of Kate Middleton and Prince William. The couple struggles to keep their relationship together in the face of intense media scrutiny and family pressures, but the story ultimately ends in a fairytale wedding.

title: Death of a Superhero
cast: Andy Serkis, Thomas Brodie-Sangster, Michael McElhatton, Sharon Horgan, Aisling Loftus
description: A dying 15-year-old boy draws stories of an invincible superhero as he struggles with his mortality.

title: Angels of Sex
cast: Astrid Bergès-Frisbey, Llorenç González, Álvaro Cervantes, Ricard Farré, Lluïsa Castell
description: Struggling martial artist and dancer Bruno loves his girlfriend Carla, but when he meets fellow dancer Rai, serious sparks begin to fly, opening the couple up to new possibilities. A new generation navigates sexual fluidity, torn affections, and open relationships in this complicated love triangle.

title: What the Day Owes the Night
cast: Nora Arnezeder, Fu'ad Aït Aattou, Anne Parillaud, Vincent Perez, Anne Consigny
description: Algeria, the 1930s. Younes is nine years old when he is put in his uncle's care in Oran. Rebaptized Jonas, he grows up among the Rio Salado youths, with whom he becomes friends. Emilie is one of the gang; everyone is in love with her. A great love story develops between Jonas and Emilie, which is soon unsettled by the conflicts troubling the country.

title: Hidden in the Woods
cast: Siboney Lo, Carolina Escobar, Daniel Antivilo, José Hernández, François Soto
description: The story of two sisters who have been raised in isolation, subjected to the torment of their abusive, drug dealing father. When they finally decide to report him to the police, he kills the two officers and is put in jail. But things go from bad to worse when the girls must answer to their Uncle Costello, a psychotic drug kingpin, who shows up looking for his missing merchandise which is hidden in the woods.

title: Nous York
cast: Leïla Bekhti, Géraldine Nakache, Manu Payet, Nader Boussandel, Baptiste Lecaplain
description: Thirty-somethings Michaël, Nabil and Sylvain head to New York to surprise their friend Samia on her birthday, secretly arranged with the help of another friend, Gabrielle. The two women had moved to NYC two years previously to try their luck. Samia shares a fabulous loft with a renowned American actress and works as her assistant. Gabrielle has a more mundane job in a small retirement home. Transposed to New York, the close bonds formed over the years between the five friends from a housing project on the outskirts of Paris take on a different aspect. The laughter and emotion is dictated by the adventures they share during their stay, from the daily lives of the women to the discovery of this cult city.

title: Beneath
cast: Brent Briscoe, Kurt Caceres, Eric Etebari, Jeff Fahey, Joey Kern
description: A crew of coal miners becomes trapped 600 feet below ground after a disastrous collapse.  As the air grows more toxic and time runs out, they slowly descend into madness and begin to turn on one another.  Inspired by true events.

title: The Secret Sex Life of a Single Mom
cast: Ashley Jones, Alex Carter, Scott Gibson, Cynthia Preston, Jeff Roop
description: A divorced woman finds sexual liberation through online dating.

title: Cowspiracy: The Sustainability Secret
cast: Kip Andersen
description: Follow the shocking, yet humorous, journey of an aspiring environmentalist, as he daringly seeks to find the real solution to the most pressing environmental issues and true path to sustainability.

title: Khoobsurat
cast: Sonam Kapoor Ahuja, Fawad Khan, Kirron Kher, Ratna Pathak Shah, Aditi Rao Hydari
description: A vibrant, hopelessly romantic physiotherapist meets a handsome young Rajput prince who is the complete opposite of her – and is engaged to someone else.

title: The Ouija Experiment 2: Theatre of Death
cast: Justin Armstrong, Swisyzinna, Israel Luna, Nicole Holt, Gerald Crum
description: A fun filled weekend turns deadly when a group of unsuspecting theatre goers are trapped inside, after a ravenous spirit is resurrected and released from a Ouija board. They must confront their most terrifying fears and destroy the spirit before it finds and kills them first.

title: Girl in the Box
cast: Addison Timlin, Zane Holtz, Zelda Williams, Matt Cooke, Shileen Paton
description: A hitchhiking woman is abducted by a young couple and held captive for seven years, during which time she's tortured and forced to live as a slave to her captors.

title: The Beatles: Eight Days a Week - The Touring Years
cast: Paul McCartney, Ringo Starr, John Lennon, George Harrison, Larry Kane
country: United Kingdom, United States of America
description: The Beatles stormed through Europe's music scene in 1963, and, in 1964, they conquered America. Their groundbreaking world tours changed global youth culture forever and, arguably, invented mass entertainment as we know it today. All the while, the group were composing and recording a series of extraordinarily successful singles and albums. However the relentless pressure of such unprecedented fame, that in 1966 became uncontrollable turmoil, led to the decision to stop touring. In the ensuing years The Beatles were then free to focus on a series of albums that changed the face of recorded music.

title: Love, Lies
cast: Han Hyo-joo, Chun Woo-hee, Yoo Yeon-seok, Park Sung-woong, Jang Young-nam
description: Two best friends, So-yool and Yeon-hee, dream of becoming the top artists in Seoul together. But their friendship doesn't last long as Yoon-woo, So-yool's first love and songwriter, falls in love with Yeon-hee and her voice. So-yool's feeling of jealousy and inferiority towards Yeon-hee grows by the day, and she eventually makes a drastic decision to bring the two lovers down.

title: Double D Dude Ranch
cast: Bridgette B, Allie James, Raven Rockette, Frankie Cullen, Andy San Dimas
description: When a beautiful, but greedy and conniving, temptress attempts to take over the DD Dude Ranch, the very busty owner and the ranch hands that work there must pull together to outsmart her and thwart her evil plan.

title: Picture of Beauty
cast: Danielle Rose, Taylor Sands, Paweł Hajnos, Magdalena Bochan-Jachimek, Joanna Mazewska
description: In an early 20th century village, a painter with an unusual commission finds two pretty girls two model for him. The girls slowly come of age while exploring their sexuality and finding liberation in a repressed society.

title: Down
cast: Natalie Martinez, Matt Lauria, Christina Leone, Arnie Pantoja
description: A pair of coworkers gets trapped in an elevator over a long weekend, but what at first promises to be a romantic connection turns nefarious as each party begins to reveal who they truly are.

title: Too Close for Christmas
cast: Chad Michael Murray, Jessica Lowndes, Steve Byers, Rob Stewart, Deanna Jarvis
description: When Hayley accepts an invitation to spend Christmas with her sister’s new in-laws, her seemingly perfect holiday takes a turn when Paul, Hayley's brother-in-law's brother, unexpectedly shows up. Still harboring a grudge against Paul for ending her last relationship, Hayley reluctantly spends time with Paul and slowly realizes she may have been too quick a judge on Paul

title: Smile
cast: Yollotl Manzur, Miguel Barreiro
description: A lonely man is invited to dinner by the woman who spies every night with his camera. The secrets will come to light, when both want to satisfy their desires.

title: 20th Century Girl
cast: Kim You-jung, Byeon Woo-seok, Park Jung-woo, Roh Yoon-seo, Kim Sung-kyung
description: In 1999, a teen girl keeps close tabs on a boy in school on behalf of her deeply smitten best friend – then she gets swept up in a love story of her own.

title: Sick
cast: Gideon Adlon, Bethlehem Million, Dylan Sprayberry, Marc Menchaca, Jane Adams
description: While quarantining at her family's lake house during the pandemic, Parker and her best friend are threatened by an unexpected visitor.

title: The Quiet Girl
cast: Catherine Clinch, Carrie Crowley, Andrew Bennett, Michael Patric, Kate Nic Chonaonaigh
description: A quiet, neglected girl is sent away from her dysfunctional family to live with relatives for the summer. She blossoms in their care, but in this house where there are meant to be no secrets, she discovers one.

title: The Good Neighbor
cast: Jonathan Rhys Meyers, Luke Kleintank, Eloise Smyth, Bruce Davison, Ieva Florence-Vīksne
description: A nightmarish evening unfolds for David, a former New York Times journalist, when he and his strange new neighbor Robert, accidentally hit a girl on her bike. Buzzed and disoriented, David lets Robert convince him to flee the scene and leave the girl for dead, in order to protect his career. Robert shows no remorse, and in the name of friendship he does unspeakable things to protect the secret. Now that the police are full-on hunting for the hit-and-run killer, things begin to spiral out of control when David’s local newspaper sends him to cover the story where he meets the deceased girl’s sister Vanessa. Despite the circumstances, and her deep desire to find her sister’s killer, the two immediately have a romantic connection, which surprises and haunts David, while pushing Robert to take brutal steps to keep his new friend to himself.

title: The Stranger in Our Bed
cast: Emily Berrington, Ben Lloyd-Hughes, Samantha Bond, Joseph Marcell, Nina Wadia
description: A newly married woman leaves her wealthy husband for a lover who mysteriously disappears. Things start to unravel and become life-threatening on a trip to the husband's family estate.

title: No Dogs or Italians Allowed
cast: Ariane Ascaride, Alain Ughetto, Stefano Paganini, Diego Giuliani, Christophe Gatto
description: Early 20th century, in the Ughetto family's home village, Ughettera, Northern Italy. Life in the region had become very difficult and the Ughettos dreamed of a better life abroad. Legend has it that Luigi Ughetto crossed the Alps and started a new life in France, thus changing his beloved family's destiny forever. His grandson retraces their story.

title: Scrapper
cast: Lola Campbell, Harris Dickinson, Alin Uzun, Laura Aikman, Ambreen Razia
description: A resourceful 12-year-old, who secretly lives alone in her flat in a working-class suburb of London, makes money stealing bikes with her best friend Ali and keeps the social workers off her back by pretending to live with an uncle. But when her estranged father turns up out of the blue, she's forced to confront reality.

title: Parachute
cast: Courtney Eaton, Thomas Mann, Francesca Reale, Gina Rodriguez, Joel McHale
description: Riley has recently been discharged from rehab after struggling with food and body image issues. She soon meets Ethan and finds herself navigating the line between unconditional love and a new addiction.

title: L'apprendissage
cast: Eleonora Romanato, Christian Vaccari

title: Beyond Billiards
director: Mateo Garmaz, Florencia Dufou, Octo Parodi
cast: Florencia Dufou, Octo Parodi, Mateo Garmaz, Guadalupe Bisso
description: After a long working day, Dolores and Amadeo decide to play a round of billiards. The atmosphere turns pleasant and emotions from the past resurface. At this point Amadeo tries to make a move but is rejected by Dolores, who sees him off and goes to sleep. Little does she know that she is about to go through a decisive night during which her life will be at stake.

title: THE STOP
cast: Charlotte Waite, Ziad El Tobgy, Finn Middleton, James Ford, Lucas Stace
description: On a cold bus stop bench a young woman evening takes a terrifying turn when she faces relentless and disgusting harassment from a group of young men. But when a stranger she once regarded as threatening and dangerous steps in to defend her, she is compelled to re-evaluate her preconceived judgements of people.

title: Daughters & Sons
cast: Beatrice Kitsos, Robert Kitsos, Laika, Henry
description: A daughter struggles to talk to her father, who is also a son.

title: Non-Stop
cast: Jonathan Ogden, Archie Bysouth
description: A young British racing driver faces an international challenge after overcoming struggles early in his life. Will he regain control of his future?

title: El show de Topo
description: After his show got cancelled, Topo has to deal with a new life and a new family.

title: Midwestern Cowboy
cast: Logan Hopp, Atticus Marse, Everett Hake, Calvin Wolfe
description: After The Fall, a lone Cowboy wanders the apocalyptic winter landscape to achieve his sole mission- survive.

title: Temporary
cast: Dane Dal Bianco, Brenden Mehall, Chris Korb
description: On a trip into Chicago to buy allergy pills, Ben runs into an old high school friend.

title: TrenanT
cast: Florencia Halbide, Bela Spatik

title: The Artist's Subject
cast: Rachel Hu, Colton Redmond, Jack Crider
description: Officers Grant and Mills carry out a routine missing persons check but find that they may be more connected to the investigation than they thought.

title: Ethel
cast: Ethel Gonzalez, Jime, Joan, Raquel, Carolina

title: Hearts of Darkness: The Making of the Final Friday
cast: Adam Marcus, Kane Hodder, John D. LeMay, Steven Williams, Julie Michaels
description: In 1993, Jason Voorhees went to hell in what is one of the most polarizing instalments in the franchise. The Dark Heart of Jason Voorhees, produced by The Final Friday's director Adam Marcus & Creator Nick Hunt, goes behind the scenes and provides a never-before-seen look at the 9th instalment of one of the most iconic franchises in the horror genre.

title: The Man Who Wanted Everything
cast: Israel Roberto Perez II, Anisa Gonzalez, Katie Monzon, Chad Hamel, Ali Chavez
description: A musical short film that follows Amadei, an impulsive, selfish, and broke college student. After getting his proposal rejected by his girlfriend of two months, he sets off to win her over, but ends up on a journey of self-discovery.

title: Seventh Art is Unique
cast: Kevin Horikoshi, Marcelo V. Braz, Enzo Paulo, Denis Garcia, Guilherme Nunes
description: Seventh art is unique addresses people's relationship with a movie theater or film. What feelings do they feel? What changes in you when you go to the movies? It also addresses Jair Bolsonaro's harsh criticism of culture and cinema in Brazil.

title: Recompense
cast: Thomas Weber, Donavan Smalley
description: You steal from the boss, you pay the price.

title: Leave a Message
cast: Jonathan Maher, Xander Allen
description: A young man listens to voice mails from his father.

title: The Walker
cast: Alex Hyde-White, Thomas Carter Rochester, Anna Faulkner
description: A older man in physical therapy refuses to use his walker to exercise to rehab his knee, and he spends his days living in depression and frustration until one night an intruder breaks into his house.

title: Worm-ance
cast: Gary Nickols, Gracie Hamlin
description: A young man's patience is challenged by his girlfriend's odd questions.

title: Occupied
cast: Hannah Pendergrass, Seraphina Curtin
description: Haley spends the weekend house-sitting, and things get pretty weird at night.

title: The Oliver Theory
cast: Audrey Hunt, Kylie Conklin, Charlie Bantner, Cherri Lorenz
description: A teenage girl texts the wrong boy about going on a date.

title: Group Study
cast: Natalie Tran, Ryan Kim, Markus Lee, Jet Sullivan, Elias Zavala
description: A group of undergrads are up late studying when a threat emerges from the shadows to tear them apart.

title: Warp Weft Water Weeds
cast: Elizabeth Bradford
description: Elizabeth Bradford draws inspiration for her paintings from a profound connection to nature through direct observations while hiking or kayaking primarily in the Appalachian Mountains and foothills where she resides.

title: Dollar Babys
cast: Shannon Haly, Kyra Green, Natasha Farkas, Megan Haly
description: Stuck for cash, a queer couple venture into the 'Girls Club' of online sex work.
